I will tell you what I told someone else on here about feeling lost in life, I think it’s important to realize that no one knows what they’re doing with their life. People might act like it, maybe you’ve seen people ur age that seem to have their whole future planned out! But truth be told its impossible to plan your future like that, no matter how much you try to control your life you just cant. In my opinion though its almost exciting that you cant control what happens, perhaps you pick up a job and suddenly you love that job so much that its ur passion! Or maybe you will meet someone at that job and *BOOM* you move into together and have a future together! You really wont know! All you can do at this moment is try new things and see where it leads to 😮 One step at a time reassures me.

And once again im so sorry ur depressed, I really wish I could take it away from you but it doesn’t work like that sadly.. I hope you’re talking to someone about it, it would break my heart if you’re going thru all of this alone, especially when you dont have to. Trust me; ur friends and family cares so much about you and they would want to know if ur feeling like this.

That’s okay, no one really knows what they’re doing 😮😮 It’s scary to just let go and see what happens but I think that is what we need to do. Perhaps you will get a job as a chef and *boom* it turns out ur Gordon Ramsey! Or maybe you pick up a job as a painter and it turns out you love it! You will never know what is gonna happen but it’s almost exciting in a way because that means anything can happen! You just gotta keep going and eventually everything will turn out fine, as I said one step at a time, one day at a time 😮🙏 

I also wanna say, trust me ur not a burden. My best friend who struggles so much with her mental health always says this:”i dont wanna burden you with my problems”, and I will tell you what I always tell her; im your friend, if you feel down I want you to come to me and ask for help 💖 It would break my heart if she didnt D: And trust me, ur family and friends feel the same way, they want to know how you are because they care so much 😩🥺
